w01-week-row-three.observed_description: The approved 4.9 whiteboard month calendar (header 05 / 2023, dates 1 to 31) with one long dark-blue freehand loop around the whole third row, boxes 15 to 21. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
w01-week-row-three.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): one loop around seven days reads as a week at 180 px.

w02-weekend-row-two.observed_description: The approved 4.9 whiteboard month calendar with one dark-blue freehand loop around boxes 13 and 14 together, the last two days of the second row. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
w02-weekend-row-two.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the two looped end-of-week days read as a weekend at 180 px.
